operation: Read-only source/evidence review plus creation of this allowlist and sanitized rejection summary; no git add, copying, publishing, commit or deletion.
scope: Minimal selected document/screen samples plus linked textual evidence and command history. Local synthetic evidence only. This manifest is an exact current snapshot, not permission to recursively publish the evidence tree.

selectionGroups.44criteria: agent-c/acceptance-results-draft.json is a conservative draft; its referenced evidence was selected. Final44/52 reconciliation and final browser acceptance remain owned by coordinator/C; no draft is relabeled final.
selectionGroups.rawUx: Actual actions/course-actions/registration-actions/acceptance/PLAYBACK_ACCEPTANCE records are included with independent UX_METRICS_REVIEW. Different counting conventions, prepared-state boundaries and missing values remain unchanged.
selectionGroups.load: agent-c/load-1792017682452.json retains all400samples, observed100inflight,p95 799.1326ms,0%unexpected5xx and actual local dataset/runtime.
selectionGroups.storage: agent-a/STORAGE_ACCEPTANCE.json and RESTORED_OUTBOX_ACCEPTANCE.json preserve migration/backup/restore/restarted outbox exact commands/hashes; no database dump/private storage payload is selected.
selectionGroups.sixteenForms: agent-a/RENDER_BASELINE_DIAGNOSTIC.json retains all16 source/archive/current comparisons and honest nonreproduction of old unrecorded-runtime goldens; final source-fidelity test and144-test command log included. The3LMS forms are separate new output samples.
selectionGroups.commands: ROOT_COMMANDS_DRAFT,COMMANDS_A and exact command logs retain successes/failures separately. Sanitized policy rejections are NOT_RUN; original launch command records excluded.
selectionGroups.newMaintenance: C command03 upgrade4PASS and B explicit-tenant dry/apply/replay included separately from earlier fullintegration02.

hardExclusions: database backups/dumps and private artifact roots

contentReview.limits: Pattern and selected visual review support privacy triage; they are not a mathematical proof against every secret. Synthetic UUIDs, localhost paths, test names and synthetic learner/company content are retained as evidence. No real person, real-provider credential or raw authenticated browser session is intentionally selected.

finalRefreshRequired: Rehash changed final command/criteria/UX/source-review reports immediately before git staging; this report never silently blesses later byte changes.
Add final44criteria/52coverage and completed mandatory full browser report after actual execution and the same privacy scan.
Keep failed command records as failures; do not bundle raw traces or fixtures to explain them.
Read snapshot.cjs.txt privately if needed; it remains excluded regardless of extension and no source-script artifact is required for the final evidence packet.
